physical_contract.wing_body_coupling: custom flight law reads measured wing motion
physical_contract.scope: body, joints, contacts, actuation, physics options and force parameters; observer sensors/cameras excluded

loss: normalized weighted mean of active task motor MSE; hover adds 2x wing MSE; ground wing and task weights explicit; no utility loss

ground_posture.target: canonical initial hinge pose; zero wing angular velocity on stand and walk
ground_posture.method: bounded corrective imitation labels; measured posture scores are not PPO rewards
ground_posture.passive_joints: included in posture measurement; only existing actuators receive targets

wing_response_supervision.kind: paired synthetic wing feedback from copied actual prior neural state
wing_response_supervision.normalization: finite difference divided by the requested unsaturated response

optimizer: fresh Adam for declared motor-only parameter subset
physical_success: Training assistance is not student acceptance; run independent review
